episodes.title: Intro to Geology
episodes.description: Explore how Earth's rocks and processes shape daily life and reveal the planet's past and possible future.

episodes.title: How did Earth form?
episodes.description: Use lunar evidence to investigate Earth's beginnings, water, and the origin of its Moon.

episodes.title: Earth’s Crust and Mantle Explained
episodes.description: Investigate the crust and mantle and how geologists study inaccessible layers from the surface.

episodes.title: What’s at the center of the earth?
episodes.description: Explore Earth's central core and the protective role it plays for the planet.

episodes.title: How Do Minerals Form?
episodes.description: Learn to recognize minerals and explore their connections with living things.

episodes.title: Where do rocks come from?
episodes.description: Follow the recycling processes that turn existing rock into different rock types.

episodes.title: How do Gems form?
episodes.description: Explore what makes a gemstone, how gems form, and why people value them.

episodes.title: Where do diamonds come from?
episodes.description: Investigate diamond formation, evidence about Earth's interior, and diamonds' connections with wealth and conflict.

episodes.title: How Water Shapes the Land
episodes.description: Trace the water cycle and the ways flowing water reshapes rock and landforms.

episodes.title: What is Plate Tectonics
episodes.description: Explore moving crustal plates and their influence on Earth's changing continents and future.

episodes.title: How do Mountains Form?
episodes.description: Investigate geological forces that bend rocks, build mountains, create faults, and reshape continents.

episodes.title: The Deepest Point in the World
episodes.description: Explore seafloor geology through deep trenches and hydrothermal vents.

episodes.title: Volcanoes Explained
episodes.description: Investigate volcanic origins, operation, and hazards without overlooking their wider geological roles.

episodes.title: Earthquakes Explained
episodes.description: Explore earthquake mechanisms, seismic waves, risk assessment, and ways to reduce damage.

episodes.title: Can You Prepare for an Earthquake
episodes.description: Learn how preparedness can help people respond to the hazards of tectonically active environments.

episodes.title: The Mystery Behind Earth’s Missing Rocks
episodes.description: Read the Grand Canyon's rock layers and investigate gaps in Earth's preserved geological record.

episodes.title: How old is the Earth?
episodes.description: Explore evidence from fossils, mineral deposits, and radioactive materials for Earth's immense age.

episodes.title: How Do Fossils Form?
episodes.description: Investigate the unusual conditions that preserve fossils and what they reveal about past life.

episodes.title: The Future of Glaciers
episodes.description: Explore how glaciers carve landscapes and consider their changing future.

episodes.title: How Often do Asteroids Hit the Earth?
episodes.description: Distinguish space rocks, investigate impacts, and learn how scientists monitor potential threats.

episodes.title: Can We Break up with Fossil Fuels?
episodes.description: Connect Earth's geological energy with fossil fuels and possible geothermal alternatives.

episodes.title: How do we Mine Minerals?
episodes.description: Explore mineral extraction, technological demand, and efforts to reduce harm to communities and environments.

episodes.title: How Geologists Can Tell if the World is Warming
episodes.description: Investigate ancient warming during the Paleocene-Eocene Thermal Maximum and its relevance to current climate questions.
